turn2.differences: The author's c1-c4 map directly onto my step 1 conditions; folder-type and uniqueness are implicit rather than separately listed, but that is not a substantive gap. Folder 9201 is the unique record satisfying c1-c4 together.

ambiguity_effects.explain: All candidates under Client Deliverables are direct children with no deeper nesting present, so direct-child vs anywhere-nested readings pick the same set here.
No folder size falls between 2.0GB and 2.147GiB, so decimal vs binary GB readings do not change which folders qualify.
Only one year appears in the data and no record has a timestamp exactly on May 1, so the year and boundary-inclusiveness ambiguities do not change the outcome.

ambiguity_effects.explain: Folders lacking the shared_link field have no alternate link data elsewhere, so strict vs loose readings of shared link credit the same folders.

turn2.naturalness_note: Reads like a plausible real request from someone auditing large, publicly shared, stale client folders; no artificial or test-only phrasing.
